subject: hm-notes-commands
description: notes-sdk's edit commands (docs/formats/conformance.md). input.state is a notebook's state: its hm-notes-notebook document, and the items of each loaded page by the page's id. input.command is an hm-notes-command, and input.limits, when present, holds maxPages and maxPageItems. expected is the resulting state, or the rejection. The command's inverse isn't in the vectors: applying it to the resulting state, under the same limits, must restore the state exactly. Generated cases come from the property tests' generators, with a fixed seed.
